intro: CAVA's Tomato + Cucumber topping brings fresh, crisp vegetables to your bowl or pita. Featured on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings), this complimentary topping adds refreshing texture and garden-fresh flavor at just 5 calories. These diced tomatoes and cucumbers are a staple for customizing any meal on the [full CAVA menu](/), providing crisp hydration and vibrant color to every bite.
priceCalories: Tomato + Cucumber is included with your order at no additional cost, making it an excellent value addition. At only 5 calories per serving, this topping delivers fresh vegetable goodness without impacting your calorie budget. With 0g protein, 1g carbs, and 0g fat, it is one of the lightest options available on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) for health-conscious diners.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Tomato + Cucumber apart is its simplicity and universal appeal. The combination of juicy tomatoes and cool, crunchy cucumbers provides refreshing contrast to richer ingredients in your bowl or pita. This classic pairing is included free with every order, allowing unlimited customization. The vegetables are diced fresh daily, ensuring optimal texture and flavor in every serving from the [full CAVA menu](/).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Tomato + Cucumber contains just 5 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 0g protein, 1g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. This makes it one of the lowest-calorie toppings available, perfect for those tracking their intake with the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator). The minimal calorie count allows you to add generous portions without dietary concerns, supporting various nutritional goals and eating plans.
whatsInside: Tomato + Cucumber features fresh-cut tomatoes and cucumbers diced into bite-sized pieces. The ingredients are straightforward: vine-ripened tomatoes and crisp cucumbers with no added sauces, seasonings, or dressings. This simplicity ensures you taste pure vegetable freshness while maintaining compatibility with various dietary restrictions detailed on the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu). The vegetables are prepared daily to maintain optimal crispness and flavor.
tasteLike: Tomato + Cucumber delivers clean, refreshing vegetable flavors with pleasant textural contrast. The tomatoes provide subtle sweetness and juiciness, while cucumbers contribute cool crispness and mild earthiness. Together, they offer palate-cleansing freshness that balances richer menu components. The natural flavors are mild enough to complement any combination from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) without overwhelming other ingredients or competing with dressings and spreads.
customize: Tomato + Cucumber pairs seamlessly with any base from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), whether you choose grains, greens, or both. Layer it with other fresh toppings like Shredded Romaine or Sumac Cabbage Slaw for added crunch. Combine with options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) for enhanced flavor complexity. This topping works equally well in bowls and pitas, offering versatile customization possibilities.
pairsWell: This topping complements virtually every item on the menu. It pairs exceptionally with Shredded Romaine for a garden-fresh base, Pita Crisps for textural variety, and Sumac Cabbage Slaw for colorful crunch. Consider pairing it with Tomato + Onion for an enhanced vegetable medley. The refreshing nature of Tomato + Cucumber balances rich proteins and creamy dressings from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings), creating well-rounded, satisfying meals.
healthyChoice: Tomato + Cucumber is an excellent choice for health-conscious diners seeking fresh vegetables with minimal calories. At just 5 calories per serving, it is naturally compatible with the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) and suitable for most dietary restrictions. The fresh vegetables provide hydration, fiber, and essential vitamins without added fats or sugars. This topping allows you to increase meal volume and nutritional value while maintaining dietary goals.
howToOrder: To order Tomato + Cucumber, simply add it to any bowl or pita during the customization process. It is included at no extra charge, so request as much as desired. When building your meal, add it after selecting items from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) and [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). Specify your preference to staff or select it through online ordering for convenient customization.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Tomato + Onion at 20 calories, this option offers even fewer calories while maintaining fresh vegetable appeal. Unlike Sumac Cabbage Slaw at 30 calories, Tomato + Cucumber provides classic, familiar flavors without seasoning. While Shredded Romaine also has 5 calories, this combination offers more flavor variety and textural interest. All these complementary toppings are included free, allowing you to combine multiple options from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
whoShouldTry: Tomato + Cucumber is ideal for anyone seeking fresh, light vegetable additions to their meal. Health-conscious diners watching calorie intake will appreciate the minimal 5-calorie count. Those with dietary restrictions can confidently add this simple, allergen-friendly topping. First-time visitors exploring the [full CAVA menu](/) should try this classic combination, while regular customers can use it to refresh familiar orders with crisp, hydrating vegetables.
worthTrying: Tomato + Cucumber is absolutely worth adding to your order. As a complimentary topping with only 5 calories, there is no downside to including these fresh vegetables. They enhance visual appeal, add refreshing crunch, and provide nutritional value without cost or significant calories. Whether building a [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) item or customizing your own creation, this classic topping delivers fresh flavor and satisfying texture every time.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Tomato + Cucumber?
faqs.a: CAVA Tomato + Cucumber contains just 5 calories per serving with 0g protein, 1g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. This makes it one of the lightest toppings available on the menu.

faqs.q: Is Tomato + Cucumber free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Tomato + Cucumber is included with your order at no additional charge. You can add as much as you like to any bowl or pita without increasing the price.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Tomato + Cucumber?
faqs.a: CAVA Tomato + Cucumber contains simply diced fresh tomatoes and cucumbers with no additional seasonings, sauces, or preservatives. The vegetables are prepared daily for optimal freshness and crispness.

faqs.q: Is Tomato + Cucumber gluten-free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Tomato + Cucumber is naturally gluten-free and suitable for those following gluten-free diets. It contains only fresh vegetables with no gluten-containing ingredients or cross-contamination concerns.

faqs.q: Can I get extra Tomato + Cucumber at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, you can request extra Tomato + Cucumber at no additional cost. Since this topping is included free with your order, you can customize the portion size to your preference without any upcharge.
